articles.summary: Resolves litigations brought by the State of North Carolina and 11 local entities relating to PFAS and other historical discharges from Fayetteville Works, as well as the State's claims of PFAS contamination unrelated to that site, including from the use of aqueous film forming foam ("AFFF").
articles.title: Chemours, DuPont and Corteva Reach Agreement to Resolve PFAS-Related Claims in North Carolina
